description: Benchmark utilities: stdlib-only linear baseline model and MSE scoring. Includes linear regression via gradient descent (no external deps), weighted stability scoring with missing/invalid penalties, and pre-registered prediction lock comparison for shadow observation gates.
function: Linear regression (stdlib gradient descent), MSE stability scoring, prediction lock comparison

inputs.name: matrix
inputs.description: Feature matrix for minmax_fit or minmax_transform

inputs.name: X
inputs.description: Feature matrix for train_linear or predict_linear

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: Whether to clip predictions to [0,1] (default: True)

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: CSV file path for read_feature_csv or read_score_csv

inputs.name: prediction_lock
inputs.description: Pre-registered prediction lock dict for compare_prediction_lock

outputs.name: compare_prediction_lock
outputs.description: Structured verdict dict with interval result and hash

public_api.name: minmax_fit
public_api.description: Fit min-max scaler from a feature matrix. Returns (mins, maxs) per column.

public_api.name: minmax_transform
public_api.signature: minmax_transform(matrix: List[List[float]], mins: List[float], maxs: List[float]) -> List[List[float]]
public_api.description: Apply min-max scaling using fitted mins and maxs.

public_api.name: train_linear
public_api.signature: train_linear(X: List[List[float]], y: List[float], epochs: int = 5000, lr: float = 0.05) -> Tuple[List[float], float]
public_api.description: Train a linear regression model via gradient descent. Returns (weights, bias).

public_api.name: predict_linear
public_api.signature: predict_linear(X: List[List[float]], weights: List[float], bias: float, clip: bool = True) -> List[float]
public_api.description: Predict with a linear model, optionally clipped to [0, 1].

public_api.name: read_feature_csv
public_api.description: Read feature matrix from a CSV file using specified column names.

public_api.name: mse_score
public_api.signature: mse_score(predictions: Dict[str, float], truth: Dict[str, float], missing_penalty: float = 0.10, invalid_penalty: float = 0.20, range_penalty: float = 0.05) -> float
public_api.description: Weighted stability score: 1 - MSE, minus per-sample penalties. Returns score in [0, 1].

public_api.name: read_score_csv
public_api.description: Read sample_id to stability_score mapping from a CSV file.

public_api.name: compare_prediction_lock
public_api.description: Compare a shadow observation against a pre-registered numeric prediction lock. Returns structured verdict dict. Production is never unlocked automatically.
